description: A ball and stick model of methane (CH₄). Each atom type should use appropriate CPK colors (carbon: black or dark gray; hydrogen: white or light gray). Bond lengths and angles should be roughly proportionate to the real molecule's geometry: tetrahedral arrangement with one central carbon atom bonded to four hydrogen atoms at ~109.5° angles. Stick thickness and ball sizes should reflect relative atomic radii.
